scope: The complete 19-token residual prethod-/predhod-/prědhod- family in the four Latin sources after EDIT-0114: 12 noncanonical adjective/verb tokens and seven already-canonical prědhoditi controls.
choice: Normalize six prethodn- adjective tokens morphology-preservingly to the official type-1 poprědny family, normalize six unaccented prethod-/predhod- verb tokens to the official type-1 prědhoditi family, and preserve the seven already-canonical prědhoditi controls exactly.
motivation: The adjective contexts denote previous or preceding notes, theorems, proofs and exposition and continue EDIT-0114's official type-1 poprědny policy. The verb contexts denote one object, theory, element or clause preceding another and therefore require the official type-1 verb prědhoditi rather than an adjective recast. This closes all unaccented and South-shaped residuals without altering the seven canonical controls.
alternatives_rejected: Retaining prethod-/predhod- was rejected because neither unaccented/South-shaped surface is the selected house form and the official dictionary supplies exact type-1 poprědny and prědhoditi forms.
Mapping every site to poprědn- was rejected because six sites are finite, participial or L-participle verb forms with genuine precede relations.
Mapping every site to prědhod- was rejected because the six prethodn- sites are adjective agreement slots denoting previous material, controlled by EDIT-0114's poprědny policy.
Changing the seven existing prědhoditi controls was rejected because they already reproduce the official type-1 lemma and the German precede relations.
